feeds.title: Leukaemia Foundation News
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest Leukaemia Foundation news, plus blood cancer treatment and research breakthroughs. The Leukaemia Foundation is the only national charity dedicated to helping those with leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma and related blood disorders survive and then live a better quality of life.

feeds.title: News Medical » Leukemia
feeds.description: Read about the latest Leukemia News and Research in this section of News-Medical. We are a tight-knit community of scientific, medical, and life sciences experts that produce and share the latest information, in a readable, understandable way. We are a trusted source of all your medical and life science needs.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily News » Leukemia
feeds.description: Read the latest medical research and information on leukemia. Learn about the symptoms and diagnosis of chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) and other leukemia types. What new leukemia treatments are under development.

feeds.title: Immune to Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on recent Leukemia news, discoveries, and breakthroughs. We are the Cancer Research Institute, a nonprofit organization. We fund the most innovative clinical and laboratory research around the world, support the next generation of the field's leaders, and serve as the trusted source of information on immunotherapy for cancer patients and their caregivers.

feeds.title: Leukemia Research Blog
feeds.description: Headed by Prof. Dr Jan-Henning Klusmann and Prof. Dirk Heckl, we aim to understand the molecular basis underlying the development of myeloid leukaemia. In order to achieve this goal and model this disease, we use state-of-the-art techniques including a variety of CRISPR-based techniques and next-generation sequencing.

feeds.title: Learning From And About Cancer (chronic lymphocytic leukemia or CLL) by Dr. Brian Koffman
feeds.description: What started as a personal journey of a doctor turned patient morphed into a way to share what's universal in dealing with cancer, in my case a nasty leukemia (CLL), a failed transplant and a successful clinical trial. The telling of my journey has become a journey to teach about CLL, related blood issues and all cancers.

feeds.title: Dominic's journey with AML
feeds.description: Our son Dominic was admitted to Alberta Children's Hospital Sept. 12, 2013, diagnosed with acute myeloid leukemia. He died Sept. 3, 2015. This blog tracks his journey and ours.

feeds.title: Teri and B's Blog
feeds.description: A blog to share with family, friends, and fellow travelers about the experience of living with and fighting against AML -- with the goal of KICKING CANCER'S BUTT authored by Teri and B.

feeds.title: It's all brain vomit; and living with a Chronic Leukaemia
feeds.description: I was diagnosed with Old Man's Cancer (Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia) (CML) on the 19th January 2007 when I was 22. This is an open honest blog about what it's like living with a user friendly cancer, taking pill chemotherapy daily, possibly for life, and everything that goes along side it.

feeds.title: Superman Sam
feeds.description: Sam was diagnosed with AML in June of 2012, and relapsed in April of 2013. His bone marrow transplant was in August of 2013, but he relapsed again in November and died in December, 2013.We miss him every day. This blog is called Superman Sam not because he loved Superman, but because he was OUR superman.

feeds.title: TCLL Foundation Blog
feeds.description: TCLL Foundation is dedicated to advancing research efforts and providing education and advocacy to those affected by T-cell leukaemias and lymphomas.

feeds.title: Oncology Nurse Advisor » Leukemia
feeds.description: Latest leukaemia news, articles, research and treatment study results for oncology nurses to assist in delivering updated patient care for blood cancer. Oncology Nurse Advisor offers clinical updates and evidence-based guidance to the oncology nurse community online and in print. Daily online exclusives cover late breaking oncology news, safe handling and administration of chemotherapy drugs, side effect management, and new developments in specific cancers.

feeds.title: Running for My Life: Fighting cancer one step at a time
feeds.description: Thoughts from a tennis player and runner who ran right into leukemia. It is a story of running into a diagnosis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia, or AML, in 2003 after feeling unusually winded while running a 10K race. It is a story of falling down and getting up by an author Ronni Gordon.

feeds.title: Keepin' Georgia on Your Mind
feeds.description: I'm 17 and I love to read! My mom and I started this blog to share the details of my victory over Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

feeds.title: Life in the left lane
feeds.description: In 2014 our 26-year-old son, David, was diagnosed with leukemia and my dormant blog became a chronicle of our experience. He died August 12, 2015. Now I focus my blog on my post-leukemia life, manic depression (bipolar), and other musings.

feeds.title: Me and Leuk
feeds.description: A mostly upbeat, sometimes downbeat, journal of my life with leukemia.

feeds.title: Leukemia Lottery
feeds.description: An Acute Myeloid Leukemia(AML) patient's observations about life, death, and the odds of beating a disease with a five year survival rate of 26 percent.

feeds.title: CLL Alternatives
feeds.description: How to Stay Alive and Well with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia.

feeds.title: Leukemia Lady
feeds.description: The blog is about journey of Leukemia Survivor diagnosed with Chronic myelogenous leukemia(CML). Started blogging in 2011 about her journey and right now writes about it experiences.

feeds.title: Life Love and Little Things
feeds.description: A website not only about our life in remission and the things we love, but also about the little things that people do that can make a big difference. You will find blogs on our experience with childhood cancer and our life in remission. You will also find information and support, should you need it.

feeds.title: Journey of a Leukemia Warrior Blog
feeds.description: On March 19, 2019, Lukas Voelz, who is just shy of his 2nd birthday, was diagnosed with B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. Our world came to a halt at that moment and will be forever changed. Our 2 year old Lukas is strong, brave, and a fighter! We know he will beat this and go on to do great things in life. Lukas is the most remarkable little boy that you will ever come across.

feeds.title: AMLjourney.com
feeds.description: My dad was recently diagnosed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia with FLT3, NPM1, and DNMT3A mutations. He has undergone induction chemotherapy and now two cycles of consolidation chemotherapy. He is currently waiting for a stem cell transplant donor. After discussing it with my dad, we decided to put my notes and his story online so that others who are dealing with this disease can benefit as well. We hope that the information on this site help bring you comfort and knowledge. We wish you all the best. God bless you.

feeds.title: I thought I had the flu...it was CANCER
feeds.description: Finding out its not the flu, but Cancer is a life changing moment. Everything stops and changes. This is my story as I fight APL(Acute Promyelocytic (M3) Leukemia). This is story of an author lisa lee.

feeds.title: Stephen Brown Blog
feeds.description: Steve is a multi-sport athlete (soccer, basketball, baseball) . Steve earned many honors including Most Valuable Player recognition, and a Distinguished Alumni award for his charitable work in the community. Life threw Steve a curve ball when he was diagnosed with chronic lymphocytic leukemia(CLL). His diagnosis drew him to the Leukemia and Lymphoma Society's Team in Training program as a coach.

feeds.title: Rachana's recovery from Leukemia
feeds.description: Rachana was diagnosed with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia(AML) a type of blood cancer, on March 22nd 2016. Her treatment started at UT Southwestern's Clements Hospital in Dallas, Texas, on March 30th 2016. The treatment followed the CALGB 10403 plan which is a complicated routine of nearly weekly chemos for 8 months.This blog has regular updates on Rachana's recovery to good health.

feeds.title: Deals that I Make With Myself - A CML Blog
feeds.description: Rachael Bell was diagnosed with Chronic Meyloid Leukemia on 04/04/14. She describes her journey till now through this blog.

feeds.title: Access CML Drugs
feeds.description: Representing the needs of Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia (CML) patients globally.

feeds.title: Benjamin The Brave Blog
feeds.description: Our daily journal chronicling Benjamin's leukemia diagnosis, his 772 days of treatment, his life, his death, and his unparalleled bravery.

feeds.title: Musings of a Med Student Patient
feeds.description: When I was 17 I was diagnosed with leukemia, a deadly blood cancer. This blog is a story of my journey through it all and shows how I've managed to stay happy and healthy to this day.I'm also a medical student - so I hope my experiences from both sides of the doctor patient relationship can inspire you to be the best person you can be.

feeds.title: Leukemia & Lymphoma Society North Texas
feeds.description: The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society (LLS) is the world's largest voluntary health organization dedicated to funding blood cancer research and education.

feeds.title: Dave's Great Adventure
feeds.description: This blog about Dave story when he found out that he had an incurable leukemia, he began recording his thoughts and emotions about the disease, and sending them to his family and friends in a series of messages we called 'Dave's Great Adventure.

feeds.title: Blood Cancer Uncensored
feeds.description: The truth about #BloodCancer. The 5th most common cancer & the 3rd biggest killer.

feeds.title: Becoming Butterfly in Remission
feeds.description: Lifestyle & my musings on life as well as being a Leukaemia survivor !

feeds.title: C is for Crocodile
feeds.description: Caemon is a little boy who was diagnosed with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) just before his third birthday. After several rounds of chemotherapy and finally a bone marrow transplant, Caemon lost his battle with leukemia on February 5, 2013. Read Caemon's story on our blog.

feeds.title: patti moonis
feeds.description: Slaying giants. Raising awareness. Spreading blessings. Patti fights CML with the help of many. Walk with us. Laugh with us. Cry with us.

feeds.title: Moe&AML; Road to Recovery
feeds.description: Maureen was admitted to Beth Israel Deaconess in Boston MA 12/16/14 with Acute Myloid Leukemia. She underwent two rounds of high intensity chemo followed by a transplant March 19, 2015. The leukemia was in remission for several months but returned late August '15. Since then Maureen has had several different types of treatment both as an inpatient and outpatient. She hopes to go home soon.

feeds.title: Leo after cancer
feeds.description: A 26 year old writing about Acute Myeloid Leukaemia (AML) as well as general musings, thoughts and anxieties about life with and after cancer.

feeds.title: Muddling Through Leukemia
feeds.description: Through this blog, psychologist share experiences, both as a patient and as a psychologist, of living with chronic illness. Psychologist CML(Chronic myelogenous leukemia) diagnosis followed a long history of other health challenges

feeds.title: Elliott Fights Leukemia
feeds.description: This website is used to provide friends and family with updates on the health of Elliott Cody. Elliott was diagnosed with leukemia. This blog is about his recovery.

feeds.title: THINGS THEY DON'T TELL YOU ABOUT LIFE AFTER A DOUBLE CORD BLOOD TRANSPLANT OR ANY TRANSPLANT
feeds.description: Mary-Elizabeth's Return to Health after a Double Cord Blood Bone Marrow Transplant.

feeds.title: Hope's Stones
feeds.description: One of my precious family members was diagnosed with Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL). Being thrown into a cancer treatment program is scary and confusing. These entries are informative and devotional in nature, for the support of Christian families and others seeking faith in the fight against cancer. The informative entries are specific to childhood leukemia.

feeds.title: How's Dave Doing?
feeds.description: Written by Anna L. Conti, and David W. Sumner. This is a way to keep friends and family informed, without having to make a lot of phone calls, or separate emails. It was started on May 18, 2007, the day after we got the diagnosis of Dave's Leukemia, and we're hoping it will go for a long, long time. This is a personal space, as opposed to the 'professional' blogs that Dave & Anna keep elsewhere.

feeds.title: Jenny and Cali at Stanford
feeds.description: This blog is about finding humor and meaning in the ups and downs of blood cancer treatment. Jenny Lovejoy Bennett's Acute Myeloid Leukemia(AML) story and diagnosed with bone marrow transplant. Jenny's seven-year-old daughter was diagnosed with an advanced stage B-cell lymphoma. Jenny has maintained this blog to share her experiences, bringing insight, laughter, and tears to a subject .

feeds.title: Maia's Journey - A Mom's Take on a Fight With Leukemia
feeds.description: A mom's take on her young daughter's fight with Leukemia.

feeds.title: Getting Over a Cold
feeds.description: For those of you just tuning in, I was diagnosed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia(AML) in September 2011. However, it picked the wrong girl to mess with. =)

feeds.title: Jon's CML Diary
feeds.description: I started this blog to keep my friends and family informed about my progress with Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia (CML). I was diagnosed with CML on March 3, 2006 after having some blood work ordered by my ophthalmologist. I am going to be tracking my progress throughout my treatment.

feeds.title: Love & Leukemia Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cadence Grace. I have a perpetual need and drive to continue to explore, learn and find adventure and expansion of my mind and soul. Even if this is not physically travelling, or exploring the world, I like to explore the information and creative views within it to expand my own mind. I was diagnosed with Chronic Myeloid Leukemia on February 12, 2018. This is my story.

feeds.title: Nature » Leukemia
feeds.description: Latest news and research from Nature.com on the topic of Leukaemia.

feeds.title: St. Baldrick's Foundation Blog
feeds.description: St. Baldricks is a childhood cancer charity funding the most promising research to find cures for kids with cancer. Read St. Baldrick's blog to learn more about childhood cancer,specifically on Leukemia.

feeds.title: Leukemia and Lymphoma Society Blog
feeds.description: Read about survivors, research, fundraising and advocacy on our Leukemia and Lymphoma Society Blog. The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society is at the forefront of the fight to cure cancer. We are the leading source of free education and support for blood cancer patients and families. We provide personalized, one-on-one support, including assistance with identifying and enrolling in a clinical trial.

feeds.title: Leukemia Research Foundation
feeds.description: Founded in 1946, the Leukemia Research Foundation is dedicated to conquering all blood cancers by funding research into their causes and cures and enriching the quality of life of those touched by these diseases. We provide the latest updates about our events and fundraising projects to support blood cancer research.

feeds.title: Adam Updates
feeds.description: I started this site to keep family and friends updated on Adam's progress as he recovers from leukemia.
